sources.snippet: neural-pairing Two language models from different families, Quill (Qwen3-4B) and Ember (AFM-4.5B), joined by a learned link between their hidden states. No tokens cross the link: each model still writes ordinary text, and the link adds what one model reads from the other's hidden states into its own.

sources.snippet: Sauers also identified what he calls the GOD NEURON, a neural feature associated with making an AI model claim that it is God. From an owl to GOD. His research demonstrates how manipulating a tiny fraction of an AI's neurons can dramatically reshape the identity it claims to have. And it raises a question much bigger than Hoot.
